title: OAuth 2.0 Overview
description: Understand OAuth 2.0 and how it enables third-party authentication.

data.text: **OAuth 2.0** is an authorization framework that enables applications to obtain limited access to user accounts on HTTP services. It's the foundation for social login.

1. User clicks 'Login with Google'
2. Redirect to Google's authorization page
3. User grants permission
4. Google redirects back with authorization code
5. Your app exchanges code for access token
6. Use token to access user info

data.title: OpenID Connect
data.text: OpenID Connect (OIDC) is an identity layer on top of OAuth 2.0. It adds authentication (not just authorization).

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Next, we'll implement external authentication providers.
